content.short: Rizon is a stablecoin-powered neobank to save, send, spend and invest in US dollars with a Visa card.
content.description: Rizon is a stablecoin-powered neobank that lets people anywhere save, send, spend and invest in US dollars. A Circle partner, it gives users a USD stablecoin account, a Visa Platinum card, EUR accounts with SEPA access, US stock investing and a RizPoints rewards program. Users can fund the account through ACH, SEPA, cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay or by depositing stablecoins directly across several blockchain networks, then spend with a card that converts stablecoins to fiat at checkout. Rizon targets remittance senders, freelancers, creators and digital nomads in emerging markets who want dependable dollar access and borderless spending built on stablecoins.
